meta_description: Help with an OpenDrone order or build: ask on Discord or email us.
title: Support
lead: Questions about an order, a preorder or a build. Order questions go by email, build and tuning questions go on Discord.
orders_body: For an order, a preorder, a delivery or an invoice, email us and include your order number.
account_body: Order status, addresses and invoices are in your account.
topic_preorder_desc: Price steps, ship dates, funding targets and cancelling before it ships.
topic_compat: What works with your goggles and radio
topic_compat_desc: DJI, analog, Walksnail and HDZero video, which radio the OpenRX needs, and binding.
topic_build_desc: The five parts of a 3-inch or 5-inch quad, and what you buy elsewhere.
topic_shipping_desc: Rates per country, delivery and import duties outside the EU.
topic_returns_desc: 14 days to change your mind after delivery. Preorders can also be cancelled before delivery.
topic_warranty_desc: Two years of legal warranty from delivery, and how to report a fault.
topic_terms_desc: The terms every order is placed under. Article 7bis covers preorders.
discord_body: Ask wiring, firmware and tuning questions on Discord, where we and other pilots answer.
existing_note: To continue an earlier conversation, reply on Discord or by email.
